config_entries.label: Ecocomfort2 ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the `ecocomfort2` hub. Only needed when more than one hub is configured.

config_entries.label: Free Cooling
config_entries.description: Free cooling, which cools the home with outside air at night: `Off`, `Low`, `Medium` or `High`. The unit only runs free cooling in summer, so it shows `Off` in winter, and changing it in winter is refused with a warning in the log. The unit keeps the level and uses it again when the season returns to summer. All options from [Select](https://esphome.io/components/select/).
